svg.title: Black Relief with White
svg.desc: Interpretive SVG study after an inspected primary museum photograph. Geometry approximate; vivid screen colour not calibrated. White backing panel and clockwise-rotated black panel observed. Wall, shadows and depth omitted; open corners transparent.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://www.walkerart.org/collections/artwork/black-relief-with-white/; source object 2022.50; inspected 2026-10-27; hand-authored approximation.
